name: pwdev-social-media
description: AI creative production for social media: concept, cost triage, prompt craft, visual consistency, generation through the pwdev-media core (Ideogram, Flux, Leonardo, Runway, Magnific, OpenRouter, fal) with estimate and confirmation, curation, optional Figma composition, multi-format derivation, test batches, mandatory accessibility review and handoff.

interface.shortDescription: AI creatives for social media with cost control
interface.longDescription: Turn approved copy into on-brand social creatives: visual concept and asset triage, prompts that hit in two variations, paid generation only after an estimate and an explicit yes (via the pwdev-media CLI), curation with recorded seeds, composition in Figma or as a layered spec, the same piece in every format inside each platform's safe zone, hook x visual x format test batches, an accessibility gate with alt text and a clean delivery package. Never publishes.
defaultPrompt: Set up the brand context and check which image generators are ready.
Generate a 4:5 background for this approved post, two variations, after showing the cost.
Adapt this approved post to 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 inside the safe zones.
